{{Quote| When you reach Kalinda, land at the Verena Starport on Kirima. Go to the SaSassis Bar and ask for a Corellian Twister with no twist.|Lazarus Armand|<ref name="DenofSpies" />}}
The '''SaSassis Bar''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]] in [[Verena City]]'s [[Verena Starport]], in operation around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Around that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the bar's [[Unidentified bartender (SaSassis Bar)|bartender]] covertly assisted a group of travelers working for the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]] in delivering a [[modular command circuit]] to [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Intelligence Service [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Bren-Nevin Rordan]].

==Description==
The SaSassis Bar bore the appearance of a typical [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] [[Cantina/Legends|bar]].<ref name="DenofSpies" />

==History==
{{Quote|Hey, that's the same drink Bren-Nevin Rordan orders&mdash;you know, from the northwest shop area. He always comes in, buys one and says 'I've got your package' as he drinks it. That will be 2 credits.|The bartender, covertly informing a group of Bren-Nevin Rordan's whereabouts|<ref name="DenofSpies" />}}
The SaSassis Bar was in operation and employed a [[Unidentified bartender (SaSassis Bar)|bartender]]<ref name="DenofSpies" /> around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]<ref name="DenofSpiesDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. "[[Den of Spies]]" states that Bren-Jules Rordan has been on assignment for two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] following the Battle of Endor, so its events occur around [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. Therefore, the SaSassis Bar must have been in operation around that year.</ref> in [[Verena City]]'s [[Verena Starport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kirima (Kalinda system)|Kirima]].<ref name="DenofSpies" /> Around that same [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="DenofSpiesDate" /> a group of travelers was hired by the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]]'s [[Commanding officer/Legends|second-in-command]], [[Lazarus Armand]], to covertly deliver a [[modular command circuit]] to Kirima in order to repair the [[Kalinda system/Legends|Kalinda system's]] [[Kalindan Defense System]]. Armand instructed the travelers to go to the SaSassis Bar and ask for a [[Corellian Twister]] with "no twist," and that they would be directed by his buyer from there.

{{RPGseed}}
While on the way to the SaSassis Bar, the travelers encountered a few individuals. Upon their arrival, the bar was crowded, though there was still space available at the counter. The travelers met with the establishment's [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]], who&mdash;upon hearing the travelers request the [[Alcohol/Legends|beverage]] specified by Armand&mdash;informed them through code that they were looking for [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Intelligence Service [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Bren-Nevin Rordan]] in the [[City/Legends|city's]] northwest shop area, then charged the group two [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. After speaking to the bartender, the group met another few individuals and became engaged in a bar fight or two. They then made their way to meet Rordan at [[Rordan's Galactic Exotic Art]].<ref name="DenofSpies" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The SaSassis Bar was created by [[Richard Clark]], [[Barbara Clark]], and [[Janelle Keberle]] and introduced in "[[Den of Spies]]," an adventure in [[Twin Stars of Kira (sourcebook)|''Twin Stars of Kira'']], a [[1993]] supplement to [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The random encounters and bar fights prior to entering and inside the SaSassis Bar described in "Den of Spies" are given no instructions or details for how they play out, and they are presented as optional at gamemasters' discretion. The players also have the chance of never reaching the bar, with the gamemaster being given the opportunity to deem their actions upon arriving on Kirima "stupid," resulting in the party's apprehension by [[New Republic Customs]].<ref name="DenofSpies" />
